description: Local control of this machine, granted only to the app-served panel window. This is the boundary the desktop app is built around: the remote site is rendered in its own webview and appears in no capability, so a page delivered by a server cannot call these commands to widen the workspace or switch the approval gate off. `withGlobalTauri` is on because the panel is plain HTML with no bundler, and that is safe precisely because the global API is inert without a capability naming the window it runs in.
